Killarney Provincial Park - La Cloche Silhouette Trail

A rugged 5-day backpacking loop through Killarney Provincial Park, known for its white quartzite ridges, clear lakes, and dense boreal forest.

Difficultyhard
Distance81.8 km
ParkingChikanishing Trailhead parking lot, arrive early - it fills up on weekends.

How to get there

From Sudbury, take Highway 637 west into Killarney Provincial Park. The Chikanishing trailhead is a well-marked gravel lot near the park's western boundary; register at the park office before starting.
